game_title: Guess Until Right – Collapsed Passage Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, a new lantern oil challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 180 points of lantern oil by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Collapsed Passage'. region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 59 seconds.
